== Acquisition ==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
* [[Final Round: Fight!]] ([[Gunnar's Hold]])

== Notes ==
* Unlike all other skills that inflict Deep Wound, the damage is dealt after Deep Wound is applied, so using "Finish Him!" on a near-death target will usually kill it.
*Cracked armor [[cover]]s deep wound. 
{{bug|This skill ignores the effects of skills that provide health bonuses, such as [[Endure Pain]], when calculating 50% of the health; the target's health needs to be 50% of what it would be ''without'' the bonus.}}

== Trivia ==
* This skill's name is a reference to the video game [[wikipedia:Mortal Kombat|Mortal Kombat]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive&oldid=312796#.22Finish_Him.21.22 source]).
* The female in the [[skill icon]] appears to be [[Jora]].
* The male in the skill icon seems to be wearing [[Warrior Elite Gladiator armor|Elite Gladiator armor]].
